text: Diadora is owned by Lir, the Moretti Polegato family's holding company. Lir S.r.l. belongs entirely to Mario Moretti Polegato (85%) and Enrico Moretti Polegato (15%) and controls Geox S.p.A. with 71.16%; Geox's half-year 2026 report lists Diadora S.p.A. among the group's affiliated companies.
short: Diadora is owned by Lir S.r.l., the Moretti Polegato family's holding company.

source.name: Geox S.p.A.: Half-Year Financial Report at 30 June 2026
source.quote: The Group has dealings with the ultimate parent company (LIR S.r.l.), with affiliated companies (mainly Diadora S.p.A. for the portion related to revenues on royalties

additionalSources.name: LaConceria: After Geox, Diadora cuts jobs too, but Moretti Polegato invests
additionalSources.quote: Diadora, owned by the Moretti Polegato family’s Lir, has announced 27 redundancies out of a total of 199 employees.
